title: Core-26 Mechanics, Morphology and Environment Completion
objective: Bring every Core-26 species to the same MVPS mechanical and biological baseline for morphology, scale/movement/senses, physiology/environment, capabilities/natural equipment and equipment/interface compatibility, using each species' durable canon register/source chain.
acceptance: 26/26 have explicit source-backed or owner-authorized morphology/body-plan data sufficient for shared owner consumers
26/26 have scale, movement and sense integration states under the common contracts
26/26 have executable physiology/lifecycle/environment tolerance states or explicit source-blocked gaps
26/26 have capability/natural-equipment grant states with provenance
26/26 have equipment/vehicle/interface compatibility inputs sufficient to produce explicit compatibility or rejection
no species receives fabricated mechanics merely to satisfy matrix completeness
all new canon/mechanics work is appended through the species' permanent versioned register/source chain and rebuilt into content-db
boundaries: Consume CORE26-CURRENT-01, CORE26.GAME_READY.v1 and the MVPS-18 per-species canon registers before historical material.
Do not reopen SpeciesDefinition identity/source-chain reconciliation unless a concrete defect is discovered.
Missing source is an explicit source-blocked gap, not permission to invent canon.
Shared Ability/Equipment/Environment and other owner domains retain execution/stacking authority.
Lineage/form/progression/social completion belongs to MVPS-20 except where a typed dependency is necessary to represent the MVPS-19 mechanics correctly.
next_action: On an MVPS-specific Continue, fresh-read the 26 canon registers, current SpeciesDefinitions, CORE26.GAME_READY.v1 mechanical dimensions, and exact source evidence needed for morphology/physiology/environment/capability/interface completion; execute the bounded MVPS-19 tranche under OPS3-11.
